text_block_list.text:
On my way home from shopping, I find
Special
Week standing by the riverside. I
decide to call
out to her, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, hi there! Back from a day out
shopping?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
choice_data_list: What are you doing here, Spe?

text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I was walking by when I
happened upon
Suzuka training.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Look, she's over there! Wow, look at
how her hair
glistens in the light of the
setting sun...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka is just as dazzling as the first time
I saw
her...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Gosh, she really is gorgeous! I can't help
but be
captivated by her.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hm... maybe I could look like Suzuka if I
grew out
my hair.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You're going to grow your hair out?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Oh, Suzuka! You were great out there.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I wanna be beautiful like you,
Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
choice_data_list: You admire her quite a bit, don't you?

text_block_list.text:
More like a whole lot! Whether she's
running or
just standing there, Suzuka is
who I aspire to be!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Goodness... I think you're plenty
wonderful as you
are, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
N-no way... I've still got a long way to go

compared to you, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
See, I want to be a calm and dignified

Umamusume, just like you!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
So that's why—oh no! Am I bothering
you, by any
chance?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...No, not at all. Thank you for asking
though.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you are very much the honest and

straightforward type, Spe.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm just following my heart! Everyone
always tells
me that I can never stay put.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And that's all the more reason why I
wanna be like
you! Or at least, have a
bit of your vibe.
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What about Suzuka can I
emulate?
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
choice_data_list: I don't think there is anything...

text_block_list.text:
That's probably the easiest aspect to
copy, but
growing my hair out will take
some time...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Oh, what if I copy her headband and ear

accessories?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: You want to copy... that?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, totally! I could wear the same
accessory
but in a different color or
something. It would be
great!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the two of us matching in style...
What
color do you think would suit me?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, how about we look for a color
that suits
you together?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: That sounds great!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure getting matching accessories
is the
best way to emulate someone...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her reserved nature... Makes sense to
me! I'll zip
these lips up tight!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
Спешл Уик
choice_data_list:
You should consider heading back to your dorm
soon...

text_block_list.text: S-Spe... I know I'm quiet, but... I'm not mute.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: What?! How could you say that?!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик
choice_data_list: You don't need to force yourself to copy her...

text_block_list.text: I-I know it's not gonna be easy, but if I take things one step at a time and try really, really hard...
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Wait a second, Spe. I don't think you
should put
that much energy into—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: But I want to, Suzuka! I really do!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text: B-but...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
...You know what? First, I'm gonna grow
out my
hair! And when I'm thinking
about something, I'll
start walking in
counterclockwise circles!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
And, and! I'll smile all ladylike—just a
slight grin
without showing any teeth!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Yup, I can totally do this! Ahaha, I'm
even a little
excited about it!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Wait! Please calm down, Spe. I don't
think this will
take you anywhere!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
As long as I don't give up, one
day...Oookey
dokey, here I gooo!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
Perfect Suzuka copy, here I come! You
can do
this, me!
text_block_list.name: Спешл Уик

text_block_list.text:
...She's all fired up. It seems Special
Week is not
the type to give in, no
matter how rocky the road
is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even so, Спешл Уик continues to
aspire to be
like Сайленс Судзука, eyes
sparkling like stars.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She seems to have missed the point ever
so
slightly. It's astonishing just how wild
the scope of
Спешл Уик's imagination
is.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
